m1.typescript: m1 a design that sits exactly at every threshold has no findings and is approved

e1.typescript: e1 a missing feedback loop a filter after ranking or no way back is a high finding and the design is rejected

e2.typescript: e2 medium findings revise the design and low findings alone approve it

e3.typescript: e3 findings are ordered by severity then domain then rule id

e4.typescript: e4 each numeric threshold passes exactly at its value and fails one step beyond

e5.typescript: e5 the scorecard counts the findings of each domain from P1 to P7

e6.typescript: e6 the accuracy a design needs is the break even rounded up from the two costs

e7.typescript: e7 rules that depend on a second fact fire only when both hold

e8.typescript: e8 retrieval and privacy flaws are high findings in domains P3 and P5

e9.typescript: e9 a design with every flaw gets all 22 findings and a scorecard that adds up

wrong-feedback-rule-dropped.defect: does not flag a design with no feedback loop

wrong-autonomy-ignores-path.defect: flags an agent even when the path is not known to be fixed

wrong-team-price-15.defect: flags a team whose value is exactly at the break-even of 15 chats

wrong-tool-tokens-10000.defect: flags tool definitions of exactly 10000 tokens

wrong-deferral-ignored.defect: flags a large tool set although tool search defers it

wrong-eval-20.defect: flags an evaluation set of exactly 20 cases as small

wrong-stages-3.defect: flags a roll-out of exactly three stages as a big bang

wrong-retain-floor.defect: flags a retention of exactly the floor

wrong-retain-ceiling.defect: flags a retention of exactly the ceiling

wrong-filter-rule-dropped.defect: does not flag a filter applied after ranking

wrong-stale-rule-dropped.defect: does not flag an index with no replacement on change

wrong-rights-rule-dropped.defect: does not flag an agent that holds the rights and not the user

wrong-pii-always.defect: flags identifiers reaching the model for every design

wrong-residency-always.defect: flags unmet residency for every design

wrong-irreversible-medium.defect: grades an irreversible action with no person as medium

wrong-human-step-ignored.defect: flags every irreversible action even with a human step

wrong-team-size-10.defect: flags a team of exactly 10 without managed settings

wrong-sla-and.defect: flags a service level only when both numbers are missing

wrong-owner-rule-dropped.defect: does not flag a design with no accountable owner

wrong-order-by-domain.defect: orders findings by domain and not by severity first

wrong-verdict-any-finding.defect: revises a design that has only low findings

wrong-scorecard-no-p7.defect: leaves domain P7 out of the scorecard

wrong-ceil-floor.defect: rounds the review cost percent down

wrong-no-floor-at-zero.defect: returns a negative accuracy when a check costs more than an error

wrong-rollback-medium.defect: grades a missing way back as medium and not high

wrong-volatile-low.defect: grades a volatile prefix as low, so it sorts among the low findings

wrong-scorecard-known-rules.defect: counts in the scorecard only the findings whose rule id has a hyphen

wrong-stale-medium.defect: grades an index that is not replaced on change as medium and not high
